system.description:
Wit; 4 Fire; Medium (50 ft). Explosive (C): every enemy within 5 ft (Close) of the target hit also takes the damage. Highly Flammable: a Fire hit's save is a CR 2 Luck Check, and failing it gives Burning (2) rather than Burning (1). Can be made with the Mad Scientist ability (p46).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.147
